title: geo-sleuth  |  Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Wulingyuan, Hunan, China

rows.caption: INPUT: screenshot of a Chinese map-app video clip (1920x854, no EXIF). UI watermark 'uid:1898353 | v1.0.17 | China'.

LEFT: police car marked 公安 = mainland-China police livery. CENTRE: the two PURPLE coaches = Zhangjiajie park eco-shuttles (the operator states the park buses are purple). RIGHT: vertical quartz-sandstone pillars flank both sides of the road.

LEFT: Baidu reverse-image search - 90 near-duplicates from Zhangjiajie travel blogs (tagged 张家界国家森林公园 x2, 天门山景区道路 x1). CENTRE: Gaode/AMap satellite of the south gate (锣鼓塔) - wide Jinbian Rd plus a large vehicle lot. RIGHT: 水绕四门 - enclosed bowl valley with plaza.

footer: CONCLUSION  mainland China -> Zhangjiajie, Hunan. Wulingyuan core scenic area / Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (quartz-sandstone peak forest).
